visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Reusable memoize Wrapper
visualizerParams.problemDescription: fib keeps its own global memo object and checks it by hand. Move the caching into a reusable memoize function and wrap fib with it. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: fib now contains only the maths. The caching lives in one wrapper that works for any single-argument function, and it keeps its cache private instead of in a global variable.
